timeline.tweet: Obviously, I'm the Octoling with my emotion issues... #Aggretsuko
One day left until I can cry... :')
I had a fun day today and then I randomly throw up. Welp, I always get sick right before new years eve. No surprise there. Let's kick the weekend off with a bucket filled with puke! *Annoyed sigh* 😕
Not even 24 hours in this year... And I throw up... AGAIN! Well, I feel better at least, that's something?
Not even 24 hours in this year... And I throw up... AGAIN! Well, I feel better at least, that's something?

What's your opinion on posting depressive/wanting to die posts? Because honestly don't think Facebook is the best place to post such thing. Don't get me wrong, I have been diagnosed with depression myself. But I don't feel good talking about it fully in the open on social media.
(I'm normally quite scared to answer these kind of questions because I tend to have a high number on these ones.) 😶
For me it's just endless amounts of pain. Even the doctors or hospitals don't know what's wrong with me. It just makes me kinda sad that nobody knows what's wrong with me including myself. :(
3 weeks at home. All my interests: gone. I don't even have the energy to do stuff anymore that I used to do. 2020 couldn't start off anymore horrible for me and it pisses me off severely. 🙄
Things happen? You can't stop crying. That's not okay. What's up dude?
We all have those days when your mood swings a sudden 180°. I just happen to have those more than often. 🥳

Happiness. Where did it all go of the sudden? I can't escape this endless feeling that drags me down every single time. It's been happening a lot more recently and I'm seriously almost at my limit to do something I'm going to regret.
It's just the lockdowns that are going to bring me in a huge depression again previous time I've done some stupid stuff, too. :/
